name: Kaechon

queries.query: Kaechon DPRK cadastral parcel map official land registry
queries.result: No Kaechon-specific first-party cadastral registry, parcel viewer, or public parcel API was found. The first-party Naenara result was general DPRK material and an unrelated Sinuiju International Economic Zone map; it does not evidence a Kaechon parcel service.

Search results were Republic of Korea cadastral/land-record services (including K-GeoP and Korean local-government services), not DPRK or Kaechon sources. They were excluded as wrong-country evidence.

officialSources.observation: First-party DPRK Naenara landing page was identified by discovery, but no Kaechon cadastral service was exposed in the observed material.
First-party DPRK PDF contains an investment-zone map for Sinuiju, not a Kaechon parcel/cadastre service; it is not used as city evidence.
